title: Harshad Number
summary: Determine if the given integer x is a Harshad number by checking if it is divisible by the sum of its digits.
statement: Determine if the given integer x is a Harshad number by checking if it is divisible by the sum of its digits. If x is a Harshad number, return the sum of its digits; otherwise, return -1.
constraints: A Harshad number is divisible by the sum of its decimal digits.
Return that digit sum when x is Harshad.
hints: Compute the decimal digit sum directly.
Use the remainder of x divided by that sum.
Return the sum exactly when the remainder is zero.
This is the definition of a Harshad number, so the two return branches are exhaustive.
editorial: This is the definition of a Harshad number, so the two return branches are exhaustive.

tests.explanation: The digit sum is nine and eighteen is divisible by nine.
The digit sum is five and twenty-three is not divisible by five.
